ashwood.name: Ashwood
ashwood.description: Gray timber from trees that grew in ash. Felled trees give it up.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Rough-cut rock, broken from the boulders of the hills. Restoring the village takes a great deal of it.

fungal_cap.name: Fungal Cap
fungal_cap.description: A tough, fibrous cap from the Fungal Wilds.

glowspore.name: Glowspore
glowspore.description: Faintly warm spores shaken from giant mushrooms. Prized by alchemists.

iron_scrap.name: Iron Scrap
iron_scrap.description: Rusted iron pried from the Hollow and their gear.

bone_shard.name: Bone Shard
bone_shard.description: Pale, dense bone. Takes an edge better than it should.

slime_gel.name: Slime Gel
slime_gel.description: Sticky and faintly alive. Binds salves and potions.

chipped_sword.name: Chipped Sword
chipped_sword.description: The Firekeeper's old blade. It remembers how to cut.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: Plain, heavy and true. The Hollow carried these once.

bone_cleaver.name: Bone Cleaver
bone_cleaver.description: A brutal edge of fused bone on an ashwood haft. Hits hard, tires the arm.

ashen_hood.name: Ashen Hood
ashen_hood.description: Ash-gray wool, cut loose. It keeps the cold out and the mind clear.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: A dented pot of a helm. It rings when struck, and holds.

padded_jacket.name: Padded Jacket
padded_jacket.description: Layers of fungal fiber bound with gel. Takes the edge off a blow.

iron_mail.name: Iron Mail
iron_mail.description: Scrap rings, patiently riveted. Heavy, but it holds.

wanderers_wraps.name: Wanderer's Wraps
wanderers_wraps.description: Bound shins and soft boots, made for long roads and quick feet.

iron_greaves.name: Iron Greaves
iron_greaves.description: Plates strapped over the knee. Every step is a decision.

ring_of_vigor.name: Ring of Vigor
ring_of_vigor.description: A bone band set with a glowing spore.

ring_of_breath.name: Ring of Breath
ring_of_breath.description: Cool to the touch. Breathing comes easier.

cinderbrand.name: Cinderbrand
cinderbrand.description: A blade quenched in a dying bonfire. It still remembers the heat.

power.name: Kindled Edge
power.text: Every third hit in a row sets the ground under the foe alight.

crown_of_the_unforgotten.name: Crown of the Unforgotten
crown_of_the_unforgotten.description: A circlet of blackened iron. Wearing it, you hear the names of the fallen.

power.name: Vigil
power.text: Your super charges while you stand still.

pyreheart_cuirass.name: Pyreheart Cuirass
pyreheart_cuirass.description: Its breastplate is warm to the touch, and warmer when you bleed.

power.name: Last Coal
power.text: Falling below a third of your health wraps you in 40 overshield, once every 30 seconds.

ashwalker_greaves.name: Ashwalker Greaves
ashwalker_greaves.description: Light as ash, and they leave none behind.

power.name: Ashwalk
power.text: Rolling through a blow gives back the roll’s stamina.

ring_of_the_last_ember.name: Ring of the Last Ember
ring_of_the_last_ember.description: A cinder set in bone. It flares once, and only once, between rests.

power.name: The Last Ember
power.text: Once per rest, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP with full stamina.

field_bandage.name: Field Bandage
field_bandage.description: Fungal fibre and gel. Restores a little health. Craftable anywhere.

ember_tonic.name: Ember Tonic
ember_tonic.description: Burns going down. Strikes hit 20% harder for a minute.

stoneskin_draught.name: Stoneskin Draught
stoneskin_draught.description: Chalky and bitter. Takes 15% off incoming damage for a minute.

breath_tonic.name: Breath Tonic
breath_tonic.description: Clears the lungs. Stamina returns 50% faster for a minute.

relic_oath.name: Oath Ember
relic_oath.description: A guardian's sworn flame. Maren, at the village bonfire, will know what to do with it.
relic_oath.source: Defeat the guardian knight of a Forsaken Shrine and bring what it carries to Maren.

relic_sovereign.name: Sovereign Ember
relic_sovereign.description: A flame that answers to no one. Bring it to Maren, at the village bonfire.
relic_sovereign.source: Defeat the Ashen Warden, in the keep north of the village, and bring what it kept to Maren.

kindling_warden.name: Warden's Kindling
kindling_warden.description: The flame the Ashen Warden guarded. Carried home, it can relight the village smithy.
